# InfluenceWatch

> InfluenceWatch is a comprehensive database tracking nonprofit, for-profit, labor, and political organizations' influence on policy and activism in the United States.

Maintained by the Capital Research Center, InfluenceWatch provides detailed profiles of advocacy organizations, political figures, movements, and legislation to map influence networks across American politics and society. The platform enables researchers, journalists, and citizens to understand funding sources, leadership connections, and policy positions of influential institutions.

## Core Database Archives

- [Home](https://www.influencewatch.org): InfluenceWatch homepage: nonprofit influence mapping and policy research database
- [Non-profits Archive](https://www.influencewatch.org/non-profit): Directory of nonprofit advocacy organizations and their political influence
- [People Archive](https://www.influencewatch.org/person): Archive of activist profiles and political figures tracked by InfluenceWatch
- [For-profits Archive](https://www.influencewatch.org/for-profit): Archive of for-profit firms, media outlets, and investment sources of influence
- [Labor Unions Archive](https://www.influencewatch.org/labor-union): Directory of labor unions and their profiles in the labor movement
- [Hubs Archive](https://www.influencewatch.org/hub): Directory of influence hubs tracking policy issues and activist networks
- [Movements Archive](https://www.influencewatch.org/movement): Directory of political and social movements tracked by InfluenceWatch

## Organizations & Entities

- [Other Groups Archive](https://www.influencewatch.org/organization): Archive of advocacy organizations, campaigns, and activist groups
- [Political Parties/527 Archive](https://www.influencewatch.org/political-party): Directory of PACs, Super PACs, and 527 political organizations
- [Government Agencies Archive](https://www.influencewatch.org/government-agency): Archive of federal and local government agencies and departments

## Featured Profiles

- [The Nature Conservancy (TNC)](https://www.influencewatch.org/non-profit/nature-conservancy): Profile of The Nature Conservancy and environmental advocacy positions
- [Boston University (BU)](https://www.influencewatch.org/organization/boston-university-bu): Profile of Boston University including DEI programs and campus activism
- [George Mason University](https://www.influencewatch.org/organization/george-mason-university): Profile of George Mason University and diversity/equity initiatives
- [Forward Together Wisconsin](https://www.influencewatch.org/non-profit/forward-together-wisconsin): Profile of Forward Together Wisconsin nonprofit advocacy organization
- [10,000 Degrees](https://www.influencewatch.org/non-profit/10000-degrees): Profile of 10,000 Degrees educational equity and scholarship organization

## Policy & Reference

- [Legislation Archive](https://www.influencewatch.org/legislation): Database of federal legislation on policy issues tracked by InfluenceWatch

## About & Contribute

- [About Us](https://www.influencewatch.org/about-us): Organization overview and mission of InfluenceWatch by Capital Research Center
- [Contribute to InfluenceWatch](https://www.influencewatch.org/contribute-to-influencewatch): User submission and error reporting for InfluenceWatch database
